name: kanmi-levers-guard
displayName: Kanmi Levers Guard - SEO & Performance Linter
description: Catch SEO & performance issues while you code. Real-time diagnostics for meta tags, blocking resources, image optimization, and more.

kanmi.maxThirdPartyScriptsPerPage.description: Kanmi policy budget: warn if a page imports more third-party scripts than this. Google publishes no fixed script-count limit.

kanmi.lcpImageKB.description: Target maximum size for likely LCP images (in kilobytes).

kanmi.requireCanonical.description: If true, require a canonical link in each HTML/JSX document.

kanmi.wrsResourceNearLimitBytes.description: Warn when a production artifact exceeds this uncompressed body-size safety threshold. HTTP headers are not included; the authoritative WRS ceiling is 2,000,000 bytes per fetched URL.

kanmi.productionArtifactPaths.description: Workspace-relative directories or files containing built HTML, CSS, JavaScript, JSON, or PDF artifacts for the WRS 2026.1 scan.

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test-wrs-2026.js test-core-cli.js
scripts.guard: npm run build && node out/cli.js check
